title: Inbound message envelope, schema ar-comms/0 (Overview C11, System Design 7 Inbound): the fields every inbound kind has. One immutable file per message at comms/inbox/<id>.json, written by `autoresearch comms inbound` (an I-id and received_at) or directly by an external agent such as the Softmax IDE bridge (its own id and created; the file's name must equal its id, and created must be an ISO 8601 time). Every inbound message carries the full authority of the human its author serves. Other fields are kept and ignored. Each kind is one schema, inbound/<kind>.json (index: README.md).

allOf.x-message: an ISO 8601 created time (or received_at) is required

id.description: One safe path component, never shaped like an outbound key (M-... or all digits), which `comms get` reads as outbox keys.
id.x-message: must be one safe path component ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}, no '..') not shaped like an outbound key (M-... or all digits)

author.description: The consumer name of the sender, for example preston or coach:<player id>.
author.x-message: a consumer name is required (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-', ':')

created.description: ISO 8601 time the writer wrote it (a direct write).
